title: Voltara Divine — Litany of Lightning
revision: Draft 2 / Voltara Divine classification / forked tree

classification.applies_to: existing supported tags of every Voltara Divine jutsu

emphasis.primary: Lightning amplification — Increase Damage Given (Luminous Illusion Bind, Ethereal Dragon's Whispers; two self rows)
emphasis.secondary: Lightning damage — Bind and Whispers (two formula rows at 40 and 50)
emphasis.tertiary: Guard — Decrease Damage Taken (Voltara Blitz; one row)
emphasis.rationale: Five supported rows sit on three casts. Both Lightning strikes carry a 35% self Increase Damage Given row, live the two rounds after the cast and never on its own hit: Bind's is Lightning-elemented and amplifies only Lightning hits, Whispers' lists all four stat types with no element and amplifies every non-pierce hit; the two rows add when both are live and the 15% Lightning Increase Damage Given passive multiplies on top, so self amplification is the bloodline's identity and takes the primary route. The two Highest-stat formula hits (Bind 40 at rank D, cooldown 6; Whispers 50 at rank B, cooldown 7; 60 AP each, single target) are the kit's only direct damage and take the raw-power route. Voltara Blitz's single 30% self Decrease Damage Taken row (all four stat types, realized on the caster at cast, 2 rounds, 60 AP, cooldown 7) is the only defensive lever and the only answer to the bloodline's 10% Wind Increase Damage Taken passive, so it carries the tertiary chain; Blitz's move and pierce rows and Bind's stun are unsupported.

nodes.name: Anointed by Lightning
nodes.flavor: The storm chose this blood before birth; every pulse carries its blessing.
nodes.coverage_note: Both self damage buffs 35→37% for 2 rounds: Bind's (Lightning hits only) and Whispers' (every non-pierce hit, any stat type). 2 rows.

nodes.name: Dragon's Whispered Wrath
nodes.flavor: What the ethereal dragon whispers, the sky repeats as thunder.
nodes.coverage_note: Luminous Illusion Bind 40→42 and Ethereal Dragon's Whispers 50→52 power; two Lightning formula hits, 60 AP, cooldowns 6 and 7.

nodes.name: Ethereal Dragon Unbound
nodes.flavor: No seal, no sky, no prayer holds the dragon once it has been named.
nodes.coverage_note: Route total +5: Bind 40→45, Whispers 50→55 (46/56 with Halo of Static, the two-row Damage guardrail). 2 rows, no gates or hidden rows.

nodes.name: Luminous Conduit
nodes.flavor: Light runs through the body as through wire, losing nothing on the way.
nodes.coverage_note: Both self buffs 35→39% with Anointed by Lightning; Bind's row amplifies Lightning hits, Whispers' row every non-pierce hit. 2 rows.

nodes.name: Apotheosis of Thunder
nodes.flavor: The faithful do not wield the lightning. They become it.
nodes.coverage_note: Route total +7: both self buffs 35→42% (2 rounds each); plus Voltara Blitz Decrease Damage Taken 30→32% (34% with Halo of Static). 3 rows.

nodes.name: Halo of Static
nodes.flavor: Where the blitz ends, a ring of charged air lingers and refuses to break.
nodes.coverage_note: Voltara Blitz Decrease Damage Taken 30→32% (self at cast, all four stat types, 2 rounds, cooldown 7); Bind and Whispers +1 power. 3 rows.

nodes.name: Aegis of Living Light
nodes.flavor: A mantle of living light; blows arrive softened, as if through a dream.
nodes.coverage_note: Voltara Blitz Decrease Damage Taken only: 32→35% with Halo of Static; one element-less row against every non-pierce hit, 2 rounds per cast.

nodes.name: Unassailable Radiance
nodes.flavor: Radiance so complete that harm itself hesitates at the threshold.
nodes.coverage_note: Route total +10: Blitz guard 30→40% for 2 rounds; plus Bind and Whispers +1 power (42/52 with Halo, 44/54 with Heaven's Retort). 3 rows.

nodes.name: Heaven's Retort
nodes.flavor: Strike at the haloed and the sky strikes back, louder than the blow it answers.
nodes.coverage_note: Bind 40→42, Whispers 50→52 power (43/53 with Halo of Static, 44/54 with Unassailable Radiance); the guard root's strike purchase. 2 rows.

examples.name: Ethereal Dragon Unbound
examples.rationale: The +6 power route on both Lightning strikes (Bind 40→46, Whispers 50→56, before the 15% Lightning passive multiplies them and the kit's own buffs add to them) with both self buffs at 37% and Blitz's guard at 32%; cast as a pair, the second strike takes the first strike's 37% row. Halo of Static is the fourth purchase because it supplies the last point of power and the guard; Luminous Conduit (buffs 39%, strikes 45/55) is the all-offence alternative.

examples.name: Apotheosis of Thunder
examples.rationale: The +7 route on both Increase Damage Given rows (Bind and Whispers 35→42%, self, live the two rounds after each cast and never on the casting strike): inside Whispers' window every non-pierce hit the caster lands is amplified, weapons, basic attacks and normal jutsu included; inside Bind's window every Lightning hit. Cast as a pair, the second strike (41 or 51 power with Halo of Static) takes the first strike's row only, +42% of staged base; in the one round both windows overlap both strikes are on cooldown and Blitz's pierce is outside IDG, so only an ordinary Lightning jutsu or Lightning weapon hit takes both (+84%). Blitz's guard reaches 34% from the capstone and the root; Dragon's Whispered Wrath (strikes 42/52, guard 32%) is the alternative fourth purchase.

examples.name: Unassailable Radiance
examples.rationale: Voltara Blitz's Decrease Damage Taken at 40%, live the 2 rounds after each cast on a 7-round cooldown, against every non-pierce hit of any stat type, including the Wind hits the bloodline's own passive makes 10% heavier; Heaven's Retort and the route's two +1s put the strikes at 44 and 54 power, all from the guard root. Anointed by Lightning instead of Heaven's Retort (strikes 42/52, both self buffs 37%) trades two points of strike power for amplification.

narrow_kit_exception: Nine nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Increase Damage Given x2, Damage x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1); Blitz's move and pierce and Bind's stun are unsupported. A fourth Advanced Art would need a second capstone on the same rows: a twin of the Damage or amplification route, which opens a second path to that tag's maximum, or a guard capstone past +10. Instead Halo of Static carries one leaf, Heaven's Retort (Damage +2), so the guard root has its own 4 BP build and no node is universal. 12 legal full allocations, 11 non-dominated, every node in at least one.
design_notes: Node split: 2 Foundations, 4 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Anointed by Lightning (IDG +2) forks into Dragon's Whispered Wrath → Ethereal Dragon Unbound (Damage +2/+3) and Luminous Conduit → Apotheosis of Thunder (IDG +2, then IDG +3 with DDT +2). Halo of Static (DDT +2, Damage +1) forks into Aegis of Living Light → Unassailable Radiance (DDT +3, then DDT +5 with Damage +1) and the leaf Heaven's Retort (Damage +2). Advanced Arts are 3 BP deep; two cost 5 BP under one root, 6 across.

Flats by coverage: Damage (two rows) peaks at +6 (Halo 1 + 2 + 3; 46/56), the two-row guardrail; IDG (two self rows) at 2+2+3 = +7 (42% per row), as Lycanthropy and Tenohira Musei; DDT (one row) at 2+3+5 = +10 (30→40%). Damage (+2/+3) and guard (+2/+3/+5) reuse Taiyo Kami's Crown of Cinders/Solar Cataclysm and Sunward Oath/Golden Mantle/Sovereign Sun flats; departures: an IDG route where Emberwake sits, +1 Damage secondaries where Taiyo has DDG/IDG (the kit has no DDG, IDT or Afterburn rows).

Interactions: Bind's IDG row carries Lightning and no stat types, so it matches only Lightning damage (the kit's strikes, any Lightning jutsu or weapon), never basic attacks or element-less jutsu. Whispers' IDG and Blitz's DDT have no element and list all four stat types, so they match every non-pierce hit. Each adds power/100 × staged base per hit and same-tag rows add (two 42% rows = 84%); only the 15% Lightning passive (bloodline-sourced) multiplies. Pierce, Blitz's included, is untouched.

Timing (SOURCE_MECHANICS §3b): each IDG and DDT row is live the two rounds after its cast, never on its own strike or another action that round. Each cast costs 60 AP, one per round. Bind then Whispers (or the reverse) gives the second strike the first strike's row only (35%, 42% on Tempo); in the one overlap round both strikes are on cooldown (6, 7) and Blitz's hit is pierce, so only a non-kit Lightning hit takes both rows (70%, 84% on Tempo). Blitz's DDT is realized on the caster at cast.

Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) takes Halo of Static (46/56, guard 32%) or Luminous Conduit (45/55, buffs 39%); Tempo (01,04,05) takes Halo of Static (guard 34%, 41/51) or Dragon's Whispered Wrath (42/52, guard 32%); Guard (06,07,08) takes Heaven's Retort (44/54) or Anointed by Lightning (42/52, buffs 37%). With both roots owned, Heaven's Retort and Dragon's Whispered Wrath are interchangeable (01,04,06,09 = 01,02,04,06; 01,06,07,09 = 01,02,06,07), and 01,02,06,09 is dominated by Burst.

Row-weighted value: Tempo (01,02,04,05 and 01,04,05,06) is strongest at 20; Burst, both Guard builds and the all-offence 01,02,03,04 run 18, hybrids 15–16. Sea-King's Blessing and Lycanthropy peak at 20 on five rows, Taiyo Kami at 31 on nine. Aegis of Living Light is the lowest-value purchase (3 on one row), the price of the only defensive lever. Value options: IDG route +6 or +5, guard +8, or Retort as Damage +1/IDG +1 (no equal-total pairs, but 01,04,06,09 then trails Tempo).
risks: Classification: Lightning is a basic element on rows of 24 census bloodlines, so the tree needs the proposed bloodline-keyed label; under the current resolver with affectedElements=['Lightning'] only 3 of 5 supported rows match directly, and Whispers' IDG and Blitz's DDT fall back to None, which also reaches every non-elemental row the player casts. Normal-jutsu Lightning collision is unverified.

Broad self amplification (user-owned): Apotheosis of Thunder puts Whispers' IDG at 42% on every non-pierce hit the caster lands for 2 rounds (weapons, basic attacks, normal jutsu) and Bind's at 42% on every Lightning hit, with the 15% Lightning passive multiplying on top; a non-kit Lightning hit in the overlap round adds 84% of staged base. +6 or +5 (Taiyo Kami's two-row figure) are lighter.

Ally-targeted casts: Bind and Whispers (OTHER_USER) accept any living non-caster user in range 4 / 3 (util.ts 2747–2749). On an ally the Damage and stun rows (ENEMIES) are withheld but the SELF IDG row is still realized (actions.ts 1060–1067), so with an ally present the buff can be taken without landing a strike; uptime is bounded by cooldowns 6/7 and 60 AP, not by enemy range. Not simulated.

Layout (user-visible option): Heaven's Retort is a ninth node added so the guard root has its own 4 BP build and no node sits in every full build. The alternative is Draft 1's eight-node layout, 8 legal full allocations all non-dominated but with Anointed by Lightning in every one; the leaf costs one dominated hybrid (01,02,06,09) and two pairs of equal-total hybrids.

Guard is one row at 2 rounds in 7: Unassailable Radiance puts Blitz's DDT at 40% against every non-pierce hit of any stat type, Wind included, but Blitz is a 60 AP displacement cast (the move row carries the caster in), so the guard also commits position. It stacks with other DDT sources; the bloodline's own 10% Wind IDT passive is unchanged. +8 (capstone +3) is the lighter alternative.

Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt Highest-stat scaling), multiplied by the 15% Lightning passive, with active jutsu buffs adding power/100 × staged base, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6 damage; bases are 40 (Bind, rank D) and 50 (Whispers, rank B) on a rank-C bloodline. Each row fires at most once per 6 or 7 rounds; Ethereal Dragon Unbound is the lowest-weight capstone (+3 on two rows).

Unsupported rows and modes: Blitz's move and 56-power pierce and Bind's 100% stun receive nothing, and the pierce is outside every IDG and DDT modifier too; the passives (15% Lightning IDG, 10% Wind IDT) are not jutsu rows. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin. No hidden, item-gated, mode-restricted, adverse or hazard supported rows exist in this kit.

audit.revision: Draft 2 / Voltara Divine classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.
All existing supported tags of Voltara Divine jutsu inherit Voltara Divine potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.
Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
